components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's one deliberately soft (pill) shape; the primary call to action everywhere.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.82rem 1.3rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #c8953e; color: #03152f; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(157, 109, 37, 0.28); transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9d6d25; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(157, 109, 37, 0.34); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c8953e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sharp-cornered secondary action, hairline border on paper white.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; padding: 0.82rem 1.3rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(6, 27, 57, 0.16); background: #fffefa; color: #061b39; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #082b5c; background: #edf2f7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c8953e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Hairline-bordered paper card with a hard zero-blur offset shadow that grows and gold-tints on hover.
components.html:
Gestionali su misura

Organizza dati, attivita e persone in un unico flusso operativo.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; border: 1px solid rgba(6, 27, 57, 0.16); border-radius: 6px; background: #fffefa; padding: 1.4rem 1.35rem; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 rgba(6, 27, 57, 0.16); transition: transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; color: #061b39; } .ds-card p { color: #43546a; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); border-color: #c8953e; box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 rgba(200, 149, 62, 0.16); }

components.name: Sheet Tab
components.description: The drafting title-block tag that replaces every eyebrow/kicker; carries only real category/sector/step information.
components.css: .ds-sheet-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.32rem 0.7rem; background: #03152f; color: #f1d18f; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(3, 21, 47, 0.18); }

components.name: Process Node
components.description: A numbered step row from the hero blueprint's process track, joined by a dashed connector; the active step highlights in brand gold.
components.css: .ds-process-node { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; } .ds-process-index { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.4rem; height: 2.4rem; border: 1px solid rgba(241, 209, 143, 0.4); color: #f1d18f; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-process-node-active .ds-process-index { background: #c8953e; border-color: #c8953e; color: #03152f; } .ds-process-label strong { font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f8f7f1; } .ds-process-label span { font-size: 0.74rem; color: rgba(247, 246, 236, 0.62); }

components.name: Product Card

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Sticky, blurred-glass header nav with a gold underline that scales in on hover/active.

components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.15rem; color: #43546a; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0.42rem; height: 2px; background: #c8953e; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #061b39; background: #edf2f7; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link-active { font-weight: 600; color: #9d6d25; }

narrative.northStar: Lo Studio di Progettazione (The Drafting Studio)
narrative.overview: Adekro's marketing site was rebuilt from a generic SaaS look — blurred gradient blobs, soft-shadow cards, stock-icon badges — into the visual language of a technical drafting studio: the place where a project is measured, annotated, and drawn before it is built. The system keeps Adekro's existing navy/gold brand palette but re-stages it on a warm ivory ground with a fine millimeter grid, hairline borders, tabular data, and hard offset "plate" shadows standing in for blur. Gold is used as drafting ink — annotation tabs, index numbers, dimension-style accents — never as a filled background. Density is moderate and confident: generous section padding, but text blocks and cards keep hard edges and a measured rhythm rather than airy whitespace with rounded-everything softness. The one deliberately soft shape in the whole system is the primary CTA pill button, kept round on purpose so the single action a visitor should take always reads as the exception, not the rule.
keyCharacteristics: Fine millimeter blueprint grid used sparingly: hero panel and a couple of illustrative product-card previews only, never as an ambient global texture.
Hard 'offset plate' shadows (zero blur, 6px 6px 0) at rest, pushed further and gold-tinted on hover, instead of diffuse blur.
Sharp-to-slightly-softened corners (6px/8px) everywhere except the primary CTA, which stays a pill.
Merriweather serif for headings treated as technical caption type; Space Grotesk with tabular numerals for UI, data, and process indices.
The sheet-tab component replaces every eyebrow/kicker label with a drafting title-block tag.

rules.name: The Ink, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: Brand gold marks lines, numbers, tabs, and small accent shapes; it does not fill large surfaces. A gold background is reserved for the primary CTA pill and small state dots — never a card, section, or panel.

rules.name: The One Soft Shape Rule
rules.body: The primary CTA button is the only pill in the system. Every other surface — cards, tabs, stat blocks, footer columns, product panels — uses the sharp/near-sharp radius scale, so the one rounded shape stays legible as 'the action.'

rules.name: The Labeled-Information Rule
rules.body: A small uppercase label is only used when it carries real information (a product category, a news sector, a numbered process step); it always renders as the sheet-tab drafting tab, never as a bare decorative eyebrow line above a heading.

rules.name: The Offset-Not-Blur Rule
rules.body: Card and panel depth at rest is a hard zero-blur offset shadow, never a blurred glow. Blur is reserved for true overlays (modal, floating tab), not for in-flow surfaces.

dos: Do use the hard offset plate shadow (6px 6px 0, zero blur) for any new in-flow card or panel; grow the offset and tint it gold on hover instead of adding blur.
Do use .sheet-tab for any new category, sector, or step label; never place a bare uppercase caption line above a heading.
Do keep the millimeter blueprint grid rare — one hero panel or one illustrative preview per screen, not an ambient global texture.
Do keep the primary CTA as the system's only pill; every other new component uses the 6px/8px sharp radius scale.
Do use Space Grotesk with tabular numerals for any counted value (stats, indices, prices, quantities).
donts: Don't add a decorative eyebrow/kicker caption; if a label doesn't carry real category/sector/step information, don't add a label at all.
Don't fill a large surface with solid brand gold; gold is ink and small accents, not a background field.

Don't introduce diffuse blurred drop shadows on in-flow cards or panels; blur is reserved for true overlays (the sheet-tab's own small drop shadow and the cookie-consent modal are the only exceptions).
Don't round a second element into a pill; the primary CTA is the system's one deliberately soft shape.

Don't change route URLs, SEO metadata (titles/descriptions/keywords/canonical/schema.org), or the product copy in src/lib/products.ts / src/lib/news.ts — this system is a visual layer over fixed content and information architecture.
